name: Granicip Injection 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About GRANICIP INJECTION

GRANICIP INJECTION contains a medicine Granisetron which belongs to a group of medicines called Anti-emetics. It is used to manage or manage nausea (feeling sick) and vomiting (being sick) caused by other medical managements such as chemotherapy or radiation management for cancer or by surgery.

Before receiving GRANICIP INJECTION inform your doctor if you have heart disease, blockage in your stomach or intestines, or electrolyte abnormalities.

GRANICIP INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before receiving it. GRANICIP INJECTION should not be given to children below 2 years of age. GRANICIP INJECTION can be used in elderly people (65 years and older). However, consult with your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GRANICIP INJECTION are headache, constipation, problems sleeping (insomnia), and diarrhoea. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Chemotherapy or radiotherapy for cancer

usesDetails:
Uses Of GRANICIP INJECTION

Prevents or manages nausea and vomiting caused by,

mechanismOfAction:
How GRANICIP INJECTION Works

GRANICIP INJECTION acts by inhibiting a receptor called 5-HT3 receptor which is present both in the brain and gastrointestinal tract. This inhibition of 5-HT3 receptors in turn inhibits the stimulation of the vomiting centre, managing nausea and vomiting.
usageDetails:
How to use GRANICIP INJECTION

GRANICIP INJECTION will be given as an injection into the veins (intravenous) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

name: Leucorin 15mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET

LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET contains Leucovorin Calcium, which belongs to the group of medicines called Folic acid analogs. LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET is used to increase folic acid levels in the body, whereas methotrexate (medicine) lowers folic acid levels in the body. It is therefore used to counteract this and support the maintenance of folic acid levels. This  is  known  as Leucovorin rescue. This medicine is also used to manage a form of anaemia (megaloblastic) which results from low levels of folic acid.

Your doctor may advise to do routine blood tests to evaluate and monitor your health condition. LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in patients with pernicious anaemia or other megaloblastic anaemia caused by vitamin B12 deficiency. LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET is generally safe medicine to use with no common side effects if taken in the right amount. Contact your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET Works

Leucovorin Calcium is an active metabolite of folic acid and an essential coenzyme for nucleic acid synthesis. It can be used to selectively rescue cells from the adverse effects of methotrexate. Methotrexate inhibits nucleic acid synthesis by blocking the activation of folic acid. Leucovorin is folic acid in its active (reduced) form, so it allows nucleic acid synthesis to proceed even in the presence of methotrexate.

Take LEUCORIN 15MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and duration for you.

introduction:
Introduction About PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION

PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION contains Pegfilgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Colony stimulating factors. It is used to manage the destruction of white blood cells (WBC) in blood that is caused due to chemotherapy. It reduces the occurrence of neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood with fever) among patients receiving chemotherapy.

Talk to your doctor before receiving PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION if you have any problems in your lungs or with blood circulation. You must also inform your doctor if you are allergic to Pegfilgrastim or filgrastim or have breast cancer, lung cancer or anemia as a precaution

Inform your doctor before receiving PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION are bone pain, nausea, headache, skin rashes, pain, redness and discomfort at the site of injection and muscle pain. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Prevents the risk of neutropenia and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) that is caused due to chemotherapy
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION
Prevents the risk of neutropenia and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) that is caused due to chemotherapy
mechanismOfAction:
How PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION Works

PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION works by stimulating the bone marrow to produce more white blood cells. It also enhances the survival of the white blood cells by protecting it against the harmful effects of chemotherapy. This reduces the risk of neutropenia and its associated complications (such as fever, flu, and risk of infections) among patients receiving chemotherapy.
usageDetails:
How to use PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION

PEGLAST 3MG PREFILL INJECTION should be administered beneath the skin (subcutaneously). It is either administered to you by a doctor or a nurse or can be self-administered if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Neukine 300mcg Injection(Pfs) 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS)

NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) contains Filgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Cytokines. NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) is used to increase the number of white blood cells to manage infections after chemotherapy management and bone marrow transplant. NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) is also used before high-dose chemotherapy to make the bone marrow produce more stem cells after management. It is also used to manage infections in patients suffering from severe chronic neutropenia (rare blood disorder marked by abnormal white blood cell levels).  The medicine is also indicated for use to reduce the risk of infections in patients with advanced HIV infection.

NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Filgrastim. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hereditary fructose intolerance (rare genetic disorder marked by inability of the body to break down fructose). Before receiving NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS), inform your doctor if you suffer from sickle cell anemia (inherited blood disorder), osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and gentle bones), and/or have kidney/liver problems.

NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of receiving NEUKINE 300MCG INJECTION(PFS) are anemia, headache, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, and/or unusual hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Mange infections in patients suffering from severe chronic neutropenia
Helps to reduce risk of infections in patients with advanced HIV infection

Introduction About LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION

LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION contains Filgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Cytokines. LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION is used to increase the number of white blood cells to manage infections after chemotherapy management and bone marrow transplant. LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION is also used before high-dose chemotherapy to make the bone marrow produce more stem cells after management. It is also used to manage infections in patients suffering from severe chronic neutropenia (rare blood disorder marked by abnormal white blood cell levels).  The medicine is also indicated for use to reduce the risk of infections in patients with advanced HIV infection.

LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Filgrastim. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hereditary fructose intolerance (rare genetic disorder marked by inability of the body to break down fructose). Before receiving LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you suffer from sickle cell anemia (inherited blood disorder), osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and gentle bones), and/or have kidney/liver problems.

LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of receiving LUPIFIL 300MCG INJECTION are anemia, headache, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, and/or unusual hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Introduction About DECARB 500MG INJECTION

DECARB 500MG INJECTION contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving DECARB 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

DECARB 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of DECARB 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues passing between muscles, fat, blood vessels and supporting tissues)

mechanismOfAction:
How DECARB 500MG INJECTION Works

DECARB 500MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.

How to use DECARB 500MG INJECTION

DECARB 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor specialized in oncology or haematology into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving DECARB 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Methoxypsoralen (medicine used to manage severe psoriasis)
Oral anticoagulants (medicine used to delay blood clotting) Ex. dabigatran

Fotemustine (another medicine used to manage metastatic melanoma)
Radiotherapy or live vaccines

Overdosage:

DECARB 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

introduction:
Introduction About PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION

PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION contains Pegfilgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Colony stimulating factors. It is used to manage the destruction of white blood cells (WBC) in blood that is caused due to chemotherapy. It reduces the occurrence of neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood with fever) among patients receiving chemotherapy.

Talk to your doctor before receiving PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION if you have any problems in your lungs or with blood circulation. You must also inform your doctor if you are allergic to Pegfilgrastim or filgrastim or have breast cancer, lung cancer or anemia as a precaution

Inform your doctor before receiving PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION are bone pain, nausea, headache, skin rashes, pain, redness and discomfort at the site of injection and muscle pain. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION Works

PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION works by stimulating the bone marrow to produce more white blood cells. It also enhances the survival of the white blood cells by protecting it against the harmful effects of chemotherapy. This reduces the risk of neutropenia and its associated complications (such as fever, flu, and risk of infections) among patients receiving chemotherapy.

PEGASTA 6MG PENFILL INJECTION should be administered beneath the skin (subcutaneously). It is either administered to you by a doctor or a nurse or can be self-administered if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS)

RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) contains Filgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Cytokines. RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is used to increase the number of white blood cells to manage infections after chemotherapy management and bone marrow transplant. RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is also used before high-dose chemotherapy to make the bone marrow produce more stem cells after management. It is also used to manage infections in patients suffering from severe chronic neutropenia (rare blood disorder marked by abnormal white blood cell levels).  The medicine is also indicated for use to reduce the risk of infections in patients with advanced HIV infection.

RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Filgrastim. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hereditary fructose intolerance (rare genetic disorder marked by inability of the body to break down fructose). Before receiving RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS), inform your doctor if you suffer from sickle cell anemia (inherited blood disorder), osteoporosis (condition marked by weak and gentle bones), and/or have kidney/liver problems.

RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of receiving RELIGRAST 300MCG PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) are anemia, headache, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, and/or unusual hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

GRASTIM 300 PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) contains Filgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Cytokines. GRASTIM 300 PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of receiving GRASTIM 300 PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) are anemia, headache, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, and/or unusual hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
